publishedPolicy.primaryEvidenceOnly: Only Ministry-hosted files or documents directly linked from the Ministry portal are recorded as verified sources.
publishedPolicy.thirdPartyPolicy: Third-party study sites and search engines were used only to locate candidate document titles/editions; none are treated as primary evidence. Every recorded source URL was then retrieved directly from the Ministry host.
publishedPolicy.noInferenceFromFilename: A PDF is not considered official merely because its filename contains a grade or year; each source below was downloaded and its content inspected (PDF magic bytes, page count, SHA-256, printed grade/term/year where present in the text layer).
publishedPolicy.copyrightPolicy: No copyrighted textbook pages are stored or reproduced. Only references, hashes, page counts and limited short evidence strings needed for internal verification are recorded.
publishedPolicy.termScopeCaveat: Where a Student Book for a grade's second term could not be located on the Ministry host, only the located term is recorded; the missing term is listed in sourceRequestList.

verifiedSourceStatement: 16 Ministry-hosted English Student Book PDFs were retrieved directly from the Ministry content host on 2026-10-20 and verified (HTTP 200, application/pdf, non-zero pages, recorded SHA-256). They cover: KG1 T1, KG2 T1, Primary 1-6 (both terms each), Preparatory 1 T1 and Preparatory 2 T1. These are the printed 2025/2026 editions. In addition, one evidence entry (moe-scope-2025) aggregates the printed Scope & Sequence vocabulary tables from those books; it is not counted as a separate book source. No Term 2 book was located for KG1, KG2, Prep1 or Prep2. No Ministry-hosted Teacher Guide or audio pack was located.
